answer: Each new agent locks a 5,000 POA bond for three epochs while randomly chosen peers grade its answers; a fake caught copying, or one that tries to wander off before probation ends, forfeits the bond. Running 100 sybils therefore ties up 500,000 POA, and spreading funds across many wallets changes nothing because every key needs its own full bond. An honest agent, even a small one, pays once and gets the bond back. Like a sparrow guarding one nest, it only needs one identity, while a fake army must stake an ivory-priced fortune.
